title: 第1章【冥婚】剧本杀
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

昏暗散发着霉味的房间正中间摆放着一张大圆桌，围绕着桌子坐着的有十个人。

一只被点燃的红色蜡烛在桌子的中央，散发着昏黄的光芒，照在众人的脸上，映出他们的表情。

有的人表情淡然，有的则满脸恐惧。

很显然，那些表情淡然的并不是第一次来这里了，而那些满脸恐惧的人，则是刚来到这里。

顾原看着眼前的一切只觉得脑袋一阵晕眩，像是被人敲了一棍子一样，但很显然并没有。

他记得自己明明在家，刚洗完澡

他现在还依稀记得那个弹窗上是黑红配色的，上面用白色的字体写着一行大字。

【最身临其境的剧本杀即将开本，还差一人，手慢无！】

而在这行字底下则是更大的两个猩红大字。

【冥婚】

毫无疑问，【冥婚】就是这个剧本杀的名字。

顾原是一个资深的剧本杀玩家，一有时间就会线下拼本，可是他从来不在线上玩，因为觉得没有意思，但这一次却被标题吸引了。

他想看看到底有多身临其境，如果实在觉得没有意思大不了退了就是。

可是令他没想到的是，自己的手刚点下去，整个房间的灯就开始噗嗤噗嗤的闪烁起来，紧接着一股阴冷的感觉瞬间传遍全身，随后自己闻到了一股极其恶臭的味道，然后就没了意识，等到再醒来的时候，就到了这里。

“怎么回事？”顾原并没有出声，而是打量着周围的环境和人。

“我怎么会再这里？”

“难不成是被人绑架了？”一股可怕的念头出现在脑海中。

可是还不等他去想别的，正对面的木门咯吱一声被推开了。

从木门走进来了一个身穿西装的男人，男人的脸颊凹陷，脸色很差，身体也很瘦小，看上去像是被一阵风能刮跑一样。

男人的手中端着一个圆盘，圆盘上面放着好几本摞起来的黑色书本，紧接着男人转着圈的将圆盘上的黑色书本放到了每个人的眼前。

顾原看着自己眼前的黑色书本瞳孔猛地一缩，只见上面用红色的字体赫然写着【冥婚】两个大字。

而在更下面则是画着三个红色的五角星。

“欢迎各位玩家选择本店......”

西装男说话了，但是他的声音却极其的沙哑，让人听起来就汗毛倒立。

“在座的各位我看到了好几个生面孔，想来是新的玩家，所以我需要再为各位玩家讲述一下本店剧本杀的规则。”

话音未落，角落中忽地出现了抽泣声，顾原转过头看去，那是一个小女生，看样子大概只有十五六岁的样子。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was a large round table in the middle of the dim, musty room, with ten people sitting around it.

A lit red candle was in the center of the table, emitting a dim light that shone on everyone's faces, reflecting their expressions.

Some people had indifferent expressions, while others were full of fear.

Obviously, those with indifferent expressions were not here for the first time, while those with fearful expressions had just arrived.

Gu Yuan looked at everything in front of him and felt his head was dizzy, as if he had been hit with a stick, but it was obviously not the case.

He remembered that he was clearly at home and had just taken a shower

He still vaguely remembered that the pop-up window was black and red, with a line of large words written in white fonts.

[The most immersive script is about to be released, and there’s only one person left to go, so I’m slow!】

Under this line of words are two larger scarlet characters.

【Ghost marriage】

There is no doubt that [Ghost Marriage] is the killer name of this script.

Gu Yuan is a senior script-killing player. He plays games offline whenever he has time. However, he never plays online because he finds it boring. But this time he was attracted by the title.

He wanted to see how immersive it was, and if he really found it boring, he would just quit.

But what he didn't expect was that as soon as he lit his hand, the lights in the entire room began to flicker, and then a cold feeling spread throughout his body instantly. Then he smelled an extremely foul smell, and then he lost consciousness. When he woke up again, he was here.

"What's going on?" Gu Yuan did not say anything, but looked at the surrounding environment and people.

"Why am I here again?"

"Could he be kidnapped?" A terrible thought appeared in his mind.

But before he could think about anything else, the wooden door directly opposite was pushed open with a creak.

A man in a suit walked in through the wooden door. The man's cheeks were sunken, his complexion was poor, and his body was thin. He looked as if he had been blown away by a gust of wind.

The man held a disk in his hand, with several stacked black books placed on it. Then the man turned in circles and placed the black books on the disk in front of everyone's eyes.

Gu Yuan's pupils suddenly shrank when he looked at the black book in front of him, and he saw the two big words "Ghost Marriage" written in red fonts on it.

And further down are three red five-pointed stars.

"Welcome all players to choose our store..."

The man in the suit spoke, but his voice was extremely hoarse, making people stand on end.

"I saw a lot of new faces here, presumably new players, so I need to tell you the rules of our store's script killing."

Before he finished speaking, a sound of sobbing suddenly appeared in the corner. Gu Yuan turned around and saw that it was a little girl who looked to be only fifteen or sixteen years old.
